name: Re-export traders Dubai / Jebel Ali)

problems.words: Stock is split across Jebel Ali, Al Ras and Sharjah and no one knows exact quantities
quick_ideas: Ask each warehouse for a count of your top items on the same day, so you see one true picture
Make one person own the combined stock sheet, so there is one version.

workzap_build.text: A multi-warehouse register showing live availability by location, updated as goods move.

problems.ask_first: How many locations do you keep stock in?
problems.free_stops: How movements are captured at each site is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: A buyer comes to pick goods and we've already sold them to someone else
quick_ideas: Mark goods as held once a buyer confirms, so nobody else promises them
Check the stock sheet, not a phone call, before confirming.

workzap_build.text: Reservations on the stock register so confirmed goods are held automatically and released only when loaded or cancelled.

problems.free_stops: The hold and release rules are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Old models of phones and electronics lose value every week they sit
quick_ideas: List items by how long they've been in stock, so the oldest are offered first
Offer the oldest lots to your regular buyers this week, before they lose more value.

workzap_build.text: Ageing alerts for fast-depreciating items, sent automatically as stock passes set ages.

problems.free_stops: Ageing thresholds per category are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Regular buyers order on WhatsApp voice notes in several languages and things get missed
quick_ideas: Reply to each voice-note order with a written summary for the buyer to confirm, so both sides agree
Keep one order sheet per buyer, so nothing lives only in a chat.

workzap_build.text: An order book per buyer that turns WhatsApp orders into tracked lines through to loading and container.

problems.free_stops: The intake and confirmation flow are in the solution document.

problems.words: We gave goods on credit to an agent and payment keeps getting pushed
quick_ideas: List every agent balance by age, so you know who to chase first
Agree who approves new credit for agents with an open balance.

workzap_build.text: A credit ledger with ageing and approval rules per agent, with reminders queued for the owner to approve.

problems.free_stops: Approval rules and reminder timing are in the solution document.

problems.words: Payment comes in many ways and matching it to invoices is hard
quick_ideas: Ask buyers to quote the proforma reference on every payment, so it matches an invoice
For questions about how payments may be received, talk to your bank or a compliance adviser.

workzap_build.text: Payments logged against proformas daily, with unmatched receipts flagged.

problems.free_stops: The matching rules are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Too much cash collected from walk-in buyers in the showroom
quick_ideas: Set a fixed daily closing and deposit time, so cash doesn't build up
Have two people count at closing, so the figure is trusted.

workzap_build.text: A showroom cash log with daily closing and deposit tracking, flagging days when deposit doesn't match sales.

problems.free_stops: The closing and deposit steps are laid out in the solution document.

problems.words: I don't know which market is actually profitable after freight and discounts
quick_ideas: Work out one recent shipment's margin to each main market, so you have a first comparison
Note which costs surprised you, so you know what to track.

workzap_build.text: A margin view by market, buyer and product, including freight and discounts per shipment, refreshed as sales are entered.

problems.free_stops: How costs are assigned to markets is worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: My salesmen keep their own buyers, and when one leaves his buyers go with him
quick_ideas: Move buyer chats to a company WhatsApp number, so the relationship sits with the business
Start a company buyer list, with buyers' permission, so contacts don't leave with staff.

workzap_build.text: A company-owned buyer database with purchase history and last contact, shared across the sales team.

problems.free_stops: Who sees what, and how the list is kept current, is in the solution document.

problems.words: Buyers ask for photos, videos and prices of the same items again and again
quick_ideas: Gather current photos and videos of your main lines in one place, so salesmen stop reshooting
Update prices in one list, so everyone sends the same figure.

workzap_build.text: A catalogue with photos, videos and current prices that salesmen can send in one tap, kept up to date from stock.

problems.free_stops: How the catalogue is structured and updated is in the solution document.

problems.words: We don't follow up with buyers who visited once and didn't buy
quick_ideas: List the buyers who visited recently without ordering, so none are forgotten
Give each one to a named salesperson, so follow-up has an owner.

workzap_build.text: Every visit and enquiry recorded, with follow-up reminders sent automatically to the right salesperson.

problems.free_stops: The follow-up timing and steps are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Wrong cartons get loaded, and buyers dispute quantities with no loading photos
quick_ideas: Count cartons against the order before each container is closed, so errors are caught at the door
Photograph the loading, so you have proof if a buyer disputes.

workzap_build.text: A loading checklist with carton counts and photos per container, shared with the buyer on WhatsApp.

problems.free_stops: The checklist and photo steps are designed in the solution document.

never_say: Anything on sanctions, restricted end-users or destinations, dual-use goods or export controls; that needs proper compliance or legal advice. Help changing a declared destination, consignee, value or description; pi declines plainly. Anything on hawala, cash couriers, splitting cash or third-party payments. UAE VAT, corporate tax or free-zone rules; refer to a tax adviser. Storing buyer passports, Emirates IDs, trade licence numbers or bank details; visa and labour questions are for proper advisers. Promises that buyer demand will return; if there's a robbery or threat at the showroom, call 999 first.

sample_reply.person: We keep stock in Jebel Ali and Al Ras, and twice this month we confirmed goods to a buyer that weren't there. What can we do about it?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be fixed, and you can start this week. 1. Mark goods as held the moment a buyer confirms, so nobody else can promise them. 2. Make the stock sheet, not a call to the warehouse, the only basis for confirming. Workzap can do this automatically for you: one register across both warehouses with live availability, holding promised goods until they're loaded. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
